routines.name: bounded_bytes_equal
routines.scope: Bounded comparison across nonpositive lengths including INT_MIN, every first-mismatch offset for lengths 1-64, equal data, and cached/uncached aliases.

routines.name: strings_equal
routines.scope: NUL-terminated equality for empty, equal, prefix, mismatch-at-each-position, and high-bit-byte inputs under cached/uncached aliases.

routines.name: string_table_pointer_get
routines.scope: Return value compared with the word loaded from the retail data reference.

routines.name: ascii_upper
routines.scope: All low-byte values, extended integers and deterministic 32-bit values compared with retail ASCII lowercase conversion.

routines.name: forward_copy_positive
routines.scope: Positive and nonpositive lengths, four overlap directions, cached/uncached aliases, and full bounded-memory comparison.

routines.name: case_insensitive_bounded_equal
routines.scope: Bounded equality with ASCII case changes, length cutoffs, mismatches, prefixes, high-bit bytes, and both RAM aliases.

limitations: Unmapped positive-length strings, SH-4 address faults, and unterminated strings are outside the bounded test fixtures.
